observations.why: Directive issued in the present tense commands an erasure action — desired/required state rather than settled fact, targeting a category of knowledge rather than a specific event.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Present-tense imperative seeks a desired removal of specific named artifacts and a named person's work — irrealis command targeting concrete particulars.
Asserts a settled negative about a specific past event — the observatory's calibration of a named instrument — as actual fact.
